name: IHG One Rewards Premier Credit Card

annual_fee.note: New applications from 2026-10-01; existing accounts move to $150 at their applicable 2027 renewal.
Existing accounts keep $99 until their applicable 2027 renewal; the date differs by account, so no end date is set.

benefits.name: Airline credit
benefits.qualifying: One airline-ticket purchase of $250 or more made directly with an airline; $250 of cumulative airline transactions does not count.
benefits.note: Offered through 2027-12-31. Typically posts in about 3 business days; allow up to 4 weeks.

benefits.name: IHG food-and-beverage voucher
benefits.enrollment_how: Delivered automatically to the IHG account; redeem before checkout.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible food, drink and gratuities charged to the room at participating properties.
benefits.note: Expires at quarter-end and the unused remainder is forfeited. Shows in the IHG wallet and on the hotel folio, not as a card statement credit.

benefits.name: United TravelBank
benefits.qualifying: Eligible United purchases made using TravelBank.
benefits.note: Deposits around January 5 and July 5. The first-half deposit expires July 15; the second-half deposit expires January 15 of the following year.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck / NEXUS credit
benefits.qualifying: Eligible application fee charged to the card.
benefits.note: Up to $120, available once every 4 years. Allow 1-2 billing cycles for the credit.

benefits.name: Instacart+ membership
benefits.enrollment_how: Activate and link an eligible card by 2027-12-31.
benefits.note: 3 complimentary months, then a paid renewal.

benefits.name: Instacart credit
benefits.enrollment_how: Needs an active eligible Instacart+ membership.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible nonrestaurant orders with at least $10 from a single retailer; fees and taxes are excluded.
benefits.note: Calendar month, no rollover, through 2027-12-31. Applied as an Instacart credit or checkout reduction.

benefits.name: DoorDash nonrestaurant discount (monthly)
benefits.enrollment_how: Needs an active eligible DashPass; select the offer.
benefits.note: Applies to DashPass activations from 2026-09-01 through 2027-12-31. No rollover; applied at checkout.

benefits.name: DoorDash nonrestaurant discount (quarterly)
benefits.enrollment_how: Needs an active eligible DashPass; select the offer.
benefits.note: Applies to DashPass activations from 2025-02-01 through 2026-08-31. No rollover; applied at checkout.

benefits.name: Fourth reward night free
benefits.qualifying: Every fourth night of a consecutive points-only standard-room award stay of 4+ nights at the same property.
benefits.note: Shows as a reduced award price.

benefits.name: Purchased-points discount
benefits.enrollment_how: Use the qualifying card or offer flow.

benefits.name: Gold Elite status
benefits.note: Automatic status under the refreshed offer. Older servicing pages and existing accounts show automatic Platinum; existing accounts keep Platinum through 2027-12-31 (Frequent Miler).

benefits.name: Annual qualifying nights
benefits.qualifying: 15 qualifying nights credited to the IHG account on opening and each year.
benefits.note: The annual credit arrives by February 1.

benefits.name: Spending qualifying nights
benefits.qualifying: 2 qualifying nights per $5,000 of eligible net card purchases.
benefits.note: No annual cap. How partial progress resets was not found.

certificates.name: Anniversary free night
certificates.value_cap: Up to 50,000 points, with extra points allowed as a top-up; eligible reward-night inventory.
certificates.note: Refreshed offer; it must be booked and used within 12 months of issuance. Existing accounts keep a 40,000-point certificate for 2026 renewals and get the new annual-night benefit in 2027 (Frequent Miler).

thresholds.unlocks: 2 qualifying nights for every $5,000 of eligible net purchases; no annual cap.
Platinum Elite status, 5 additional qualifying nights and 15,000 points. Earned status lasts the rest of the qualifying year and the following calendar year.
Diamond Elite status, lasting the rest of the qualifying year and the following calendar year.

disagreements.topic: Fee, anniversary certificate size and automatic status

values.value: $99 annual fee, a 40,000-point certificate and automatic Platinum (legacy Chase servicing page).
$150 annual fee, a 50,000-point certificate and automatic Gold (current Chase application page).

upcoming_changes.summary: Existing accounts: per Frequent Miler they keep the $99 fee and 40,000-point certificate for 2026 renewals, get the new annual-night benefit in 2027 and keep Platinum through 2027-12-31. Chase's announcement confirms a 2027 fee transition but leaves account-specific details to individual notices.

The old milestone ($20,000 spend for a $100 credit and 10,000 points) is not the refreshed milestone ($15,000 for Platinum, 5 nights and 15,000 points). How partially completed legacy 2026 spending is treated was not found.
